versions.changelog:
Initial release: Control Tuya/Smart Life devices locally over LAN using tinytuya.

- Fetch device ids and local keys from the Tuya cloud once; all subsequent reads/writes are LAN-local.
- Supports reading and setting DPS values on plugs, bulbs, sensors, thermostats, and more.
- Includes CLI scripts for device key fetch, local status reading, and device control.
- Offers step-by-step setup instructions, pitfalls, and best practices for reliable local operation.
